memberships.description: Extract every purchasable membership tier on the source page separately, including tiers whose benefits require image reading. Never borrow a fee or entitlement from another tier.

membership_name.description: The plan name exactly as shown on the page. Never invent, combine or rename a plan; skip a tier whose name is not shown.

membership_price.description: The fee shown on the page for this plan. Never take a fee from another plan or a different program on the page.

benefits.description: Every entitlement and restriction the page states for this plan, one fact per item: monthly credits, included services and selection limits, gifts and frequency, discounts, minimum term, rollover, cancellation, exclusions and eligibility. Rephrasing is allowed, but every service, price, percentage and quantity in an item must appear on the page for this plan, and an item must not join statements from different places on the page (plan card, FAQ, terms). Include shared terms only where the page explicitly applies them to this plan. Never add explanations, advice, inferences, computed values or placeholders such as 'listed on page' or 'not published'. Use null when the page states no benefits for this plan or they are unreadable; never invent text to fill the list.

source_claims.description: Independent inventory of every verbatim entitlement or restriction for this tier from the source, including credits, included services, gifts, discounts, frequency, term, rollover, cancellation and exclusions. Do not copy from the benefits output; inventory directly from the page. Empty only when the page explicitly shows no entitlements.
